celebrities.name: Katrina Kaif
celebrities.caption: Rumored to make her OTT debut as she eyes a return to acting. Meanwhile, fans got their first glimpse of her son Vihaan Kaushal, and Raajneeti 2 reunion buzz is heating up.

celebrities.name: Diljit Dosanjh
celebrities.caption: Teaming up with Shakira for an Indian version of 'Hips Don't Lie' and gearing up for a Coachella BTS documentary. His Born to Shine world tour continues to sell out arenas globally.

celebrities.name: Alia Bhatt
celebrities.caption: Alpha with Sharvari has been preponed to July 3 — Alia plays an assassin in the spy thriller. Bobby Deol praised the experience of shooting with her.

celebrities.name: Priyanka Chopra
celebrities.caption: Shared adorable 'Random March' moments with daughter Malti and Nick Jonas. Also launched a new homeware brand in the US, expanding her business empire stateside.

celebrities.name: Shah Rukh Khan
celebrities.caption: Nearing the finish line on King, set for a Christmas 2026 release with daughter Suhana's debut. SRK is also reportedly considering a romantic drama as his next project.

celebrities.name: Kareena Kapoor Khan
celebrities.caption: Wrapped shooting on Daayra with Prithviraj and celebrated 25 years since Mujhe Kucch Kehna Hai. Rumored to join Salman Khan in Raj-DK's next.

celebrities.name: Shraddha Kapoor
celebrities.caption: Eetha, her Vithabai Narayangaonkar biopic, is set for an August 28 Raksha Bandhan release. Shraddha sustained an injury during the intense shoot.

celebrities.name: Deepika Padukone
celebrities.caption: Pregnant with her second child, she's using a body double for action sequences in Allu Arjun's Raka. Spotted house-hunting with Ranveer at their new Bandra home.

celebrities.name: Ranveer Singh
celebrities.caption: Dhurandhar franchise has crossed ₹3,000 crore combined worldwide. After exiting Don 3, Ranveer is now focused on Pralay, with Shaktimaan casting buzz swirling around him.

celebrities.name: Aishwarya Rai Bachchan
celebrities.caption: Returned from Cannes with daughter Aaradhya, serving twinning airport looks. Divorce speculation with Abhishek Bachchan continues to dominate headlines.

celebrities.name: Rashmika Mandanna
celebrities.caption: Filming Mysaa in an intense new avatar and co-hosted the Anime Awards with Winston Duke. Wedding buzz with Vijay Deverakonda refuses to die down.

celebrities.name: Samantha Ruth Prabhu
celebrities.caption: Gearing up for action comedy Maa Inti Bangaaram. Recently married director Raj Nidimoru and is co-producing under their new banner Tralala Moving Pictures.

celebrities.name: Allu Arjun
celebrities.caption: Deep in production on Raka alongside Atlee and Deepika Padukone. Recently praised cousin Ram Charan's blockbuster Peddi.

celebrities.name: Ram Charan
celebrities.caption: Peddi crossed ₹200 crore worldwide in just 5 days. His sports drama with Janhvi Kapoor drew some controversy over her character's portrayal.

celebrities.name: Jr NTR
celebrities.caption: Introduced to a top Marvel Studios executive, fueling Hollywood crossover speculation. Teaming up with Jailer director Nelson Dilipkumar, with Dragon and Devara 2 both announced on his birthday.

celebrities.name: Janhvi Kapoor
celebrities.caption: Facing backlash over her character's portrayal in Peddi, though the director has since cut controversial scenes. Janhvi has stayed silent post-release.

celebrities.name: Ananya Panday
celebrities.caption: Celebrating an early birthday on set while filming her latest. She also bought a new home, and CTRLZ season buzz is building around her.

celebrities.name: Kiara Advani
celebrities.caption: Welcomed her first baby girl with Sidharth Malhotra! Dismissed reshoot rumors about Toxic with Yash and has asked for privacy during this special time.

celebrities.name: Hrithik Roshan
celebrities.caption: Krrish 4 with YRF is moving ahead after budget clash rumors were dismissed by Rakesh Roshan. Hrithik is also planning his directorial debut and made a big property purchase.

celebrities.name: Varun Dhawan
celebrities.caption: Hai Jawani Toh Ishq Hona Hai opened at ₹8.5 crore on Day 1. Varun confirmed he once rejected Andhadhun, and his banter with Tanmay Bhat went viral.

celebrities.name: Shreya Ghoshal
celebrities.caption: Purchased a ₹29.7 crore home in Mumbai's Worli and dropped a live album from her All Hearts Tour. Also revealed she once turned down 'Fevicol Se.'

celebrities.name: AR Rahman
celebrities.caption: Performed live at the Attari-Wagah border in a historic musical tribute to the BSF — the first-ever concert at the iconic crossing in Punjab.

celebrities.name: Vijay Thalapathy
celebrities.caption: Won 108 seats in the Tamil Nadu Assembly elections with his TVK party and is now Chief Minister. His final film Jana Nayagan awaits release as distribution deals are reworked.
